headline: Private Consultants Trim Argentina Growth Forecast to 1% for the Year
summary: Private consulting firms lowered their economic forecasts for Argentina, projecting growth of only 1% for the year and warning that a third-quarter contraction could signal a technical recession.
why: Economic growth projections for Argentina are crucial for sovereign debt investors, sovereign risk spreads, and evaluating the ongoing stabilization policies under the current administration.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Downwardly revised growth forecasts and recession warnings indicate weaker economic activity.
